name: Pon
note: Dutch family-owned mobility multinational (automotive, bikes, mobility services); its Pon.Bike division holds bicycle brands including Cervélo, Cannondale, Gazelle and Nimbl. Its Bike Mobility Services company (brands Lease a Bike, BusinessBike, B2Bike) has been 49%-owned by Volkswagen Financial Services under joint control since 2023 (claim bms-vwfs-stake).
